name: Request hardware
description: Employees request approved hardware (laptops, monitors, phones, accessories). Requests are approved when policy requires it, routed to the fulfilment team, delivered within an agreed time, and the requester is kept informed.

verification.notes: Reference design is built on unverified reference artifacts. Re-verify after capture.

outcomes.statement: Employees can request hardware from the self-service portal by choosing an approved model, and are asked only for the information that model needs.
evidenceHints: Catalog items and variables show which models and questions exist today; many items usually collapse into one request type with a model picker.

acceptance.given: an employee signed in to the help center
acceptance.when: they open 'Request new hardware' and select an approved model
then: only models marked as approved can be selected
the request is created with the selected model linked

outcomes.statement: Requests for non-standard models, or costing more than {{costThreshold}}, need approval from the requester's manager before fulfilment. Declined requests are closed and the requester is told why.

parameters.name: costThreshold
parameters.description: Unit cost above which manager approval is required

evidenceHints: Approval rules, flow approval steps and approval conditions set costThreshold and which models are standard.

acceptance.given: a standard model that costs less than {{costThreshold}}
then: the request moves straight to 'Waiting for support'

acceptance.given: a non-standard model, or one that costs more than {{costThreshold}}
then: the requester's manager is the approver

acceptance.when: the manager declines it with a reason
then: the request is closed as Declined
the requester is notified with the reason

outcomes.statement: Approved requests are routed automatically to the {{fulfilmentTeam}} team, with no manual triage.
evidenceHints: Assignment rules, assignment groups on catalog items and flow 'assign' steps name today's fulfilment group(s).

acceptance.given: a hardware request that is approved or needs no approval
then: the Team field is set to {{fulfilmentTeam}}
it appears in the team's hardware queue

outcomes.statement: Requesters get a first response within {{firstResponse}}, and hardware is delivered within {{fulfilmentTime}} of approval, measured in business hours.

parameters.name: fulfilmentTime
parameters.description: Time to resolution goal, measured from approval

evidenceHints: SLA definitions on sc_req_item / sc_task and their schedules set the goals and the calendar.

acceptance.when: it is created and then approved
then: 'Time to first response' starts at creation with a goal of {{firstResponse}}
'Time to resolution' starts at approval with a goal of {{fulfilmentTime}}, pausing while waiting for the customer

outcomes.statement: Requesters are notified when their request needs approval, is approved or declined, and is fulfilled, and can see its status in the portal at any time.
evidenceHints: Notifications on sc_request / sc_req_item show which events customers are told about today.

then: the requester receives a resolution notification
the portal shows the request as resolved

outcomes.statement: The fulfilment team lead can see all open hardware requests by status and SLA risk.
evidenceHints: Reports, dashboards and list filters on hardware requested items.

acceptance.given: open hardware requests with different statuses
acceptance.when: the team lead opens the 'Hardware requests' queue
then: all open hardware requests are listed
they are ordered by time remaining on 'Time to resolution'
